svg.title: Position, velocity and acceleration of an object oscillating on a spring
svg.desc: Top: snapshots of an object on a vertical spring at equal time steps, moving from x = +X down through x = 0 to x = −X and back, with green arrows showing its velocity when it passes x = 0. Graphs: the position x = X cos(2πt/T) starts at its maximum X, with period T; the velocity starts at zero and goes negative, between −v_max and v_max; the acceleration starts at its most negative value, −a_max, always opposite the displacement. Bottom: a spring of unstrained length, the same spring stretched to its equilibrium position by the hanging object, and the object oscillating between x = +X and x = −X about that equilibrium.
